<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915265_theRebbe_887" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915265_theRebbe_887__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This explains that the preface about light and name in the maamar hints that the superiority of "Echad" over "Yachid" is primarily when it also includes the aspect of "Yachid."</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it may be said,</t>
    <t s="1">that this—that in order to explain the superiority of Echad relative to Yachid, [the maamar] first introduces</t>
    <t s="2">(in the maamar)</t>
    <t s="3">the concept of light and name,</t>
    <t s="4">and that the main superiority of name is when it also contains the superiority of light—</t>
    <t s="5">is in order to hint</t>
    <t s="6">that this is also the case regarding the concept of Echad and Yachid,</t>
    <t s="7">that although the advantage of Echad over Yachid is also in the aspect of Echad as it is in itself,</t>
    <t s="8">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="9">the main superiority in this is when it also contains the aspect of Yachid.</t>
    <t s="10">For the advantage in the aspect of Echad</t>
    <t s="11">(as it is in itself),</t>
    <t s="12">that even the worlds are nullified and unified,</t>
    <t s="13">does not have the quality of revelation.</t>
    <t s="14">Because this—that the nullification of Echad is not a nullification to the ultimate degree like the nullification of Yachid</t>
    <t s="15">(for in the nullification of Echad, the worlds appear as existent, and their nullification is like something additional to their existence)—</t>
    <t s="16">is due to the fact that the revelation of Ein Sof does not shine within them.</t>
    <t s="17">And the main superiority is that even in the worlds that came into being through the tzimtzum, the revelation of Ein Sof, which is above the tzimtzum, shines,</t>
    <t s="18">and the revelation is not in a manner that they are nullified from their existence, but rather that although they are in their existence, they are nullified to the ultimate degree</t>
    <t s="19">in the manner of the nullification of Yachid.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="13">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>To have the superiority of light within name (and the union of Echad and Yachid) requires drawing from Atzmus, which is above even name.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, in order that within name there should also be the superiority of light</t>
    <t s="2">[and likewise the union of Echad and Yachid],</t>
    <t s="3">this is through the drawing down of Atzmus, which is above even name.</t>
    <t s="4">For name, in itself, is concealment and cannot be in revelation,</t>
    <t s="5">and that which is drawn into revelation is through drawing into it from Atzmus.</t>
    <t s="6">And as explained by His Holy Honor, my father-in-law, the Rebbe</t>
    <t s="7">[in the maamar of Yud Tes Kislev,</t>
    <t s="8">which follows the maamar beginning "Atah Echad" of Tes Kislev],</t>
    <t s="9">that this—that Israel are called "those who sanctify Your name"—is because they draw into the name from the holiness of Atzmus,</t>
    <t s="10">the drawing of "Atah Kadosh" into "Shimcha Kadosh."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="14">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The conclusion of the prayer "Atah Echad" ("Yekadishu es Shimecha") relates to its beginning in two ways: through drawing from Atzmus, and as the actual result of that drawing.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">Based on this, we may explain that the conclusion of the prayer "Atah Echad" is "Yekadishu es Shimecha,"</t>
    <t s="1">and the connection of the conclusion of the prayer to its beginning is in two matters.</t>
    <t s="2">For this—that Israel, a singular nation, draw down that "Atah Echad" and "Shimcha Echad"</t>
    <t s="3">(in a manner that within Echad there is also the revelation of Yachid, as in section 6 above)—</t>
    <t s="4">is through the drawing of the power of Atzmus—"Yekadishu es Shimecha."</t>
    <t s="5">And through Israel, a singular nation, drawing down "Atah Echad" and "Shimcha Echad,"</t>
    <t s="6">by this "Yekadishu es Shimecha" is actualized,</t>
    <t s="7">the drawing of "Atah Kadosh" into "Shimcha Kadosh."</t>
    <t s="8">And as explained in the maamar "Atah Echad" of the Baal HaHilula,</t>
    <t s="9">that the matter of "and upon their rest they will sanctify Your name" at the conclusion of the prayer "Atah Echad" is a level higher than all the matters preceding it.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
